questions.prompt: How do you approach a payload wrapped in several techniques?

options.a: Peel one layer at a time, printing each result, until the plaintext is legible
options.b: Run it in a sandbox immediately to see what it does

questions.prompt: This sample's outer layer is base64. What is the inner layer? (one word)

options.a: Execute the layer to reveal the next one
options.b: Print the intermediate text and read it — never execute it
